svg.title: Routes to mental health support in British Columbia
svg.desc: Three stacked bands describing routes to mental health support in BC: services that answer immediately with no waitlist, publicly funded services that are free but triaged, and private counselling which has no waitlist and a fee.
svg.text: Three routes, and what each actually costs you

text.tspan: 9-8-8 by call or text, 310-6789 in BC, 8-1-1 for health navigation, Foundry for ages 12 to 24, Here2Talk for post-secondary
students. No waitlist and no eligibility test.
Health-authority mental health and substance use services, community agencies, campus counselling, employee assistance
programmes. Sorted by urgency, which is why accurate reporting at intake matters.
Private counselling. No referral, no session cap, no diagnosis on a file, and choice of counsellor, method and language. The
trade-off is the fee — which is why the consultation is free.
Most people qualify for something in the top two bands and have never checked.
